notes.title: Complete renovatie Update
notes.content:
[b]Dear players.[/b]
We have an obligation to you to deliver a good game.
In our eyes, we have not yet 100% satisfied, because to be able to do we had to switch to a different game engine.
As you already know, that has become Godot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791109/9b8dfffee421ff202ca66b812e46c1dbc50ae018.png[/img]

As a result, a few precious months were lost in the ownership of this game engine.
But now we are ready to make this announcement again.

[b]What is different about the game:[/b]

Well actually the whole game has been turned upside down, all the comments we have received have been included in the rebuild of the game.

Certain parts have been left behind, but they will certainly return.
The most important thing we think is that a game works flawlessly without bugs or other problems. From there we continue again.

[u]The last few parts will be added when they are ready, the update will be carried out.[/u]

We are also working on making this game available to both MAC and LINUX players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791109/0392f05825928954ecf47558394b321cf79e6ea2.jpg[/img]
For that, we brought in 3 different MAC`s and tested 3 different laptops for the linux.
We already have 4 mirosoft PCs windows 7 2x and window 102x all different versions specially for testing our own games so that we know for sure that our games will run on every system.
We hope to release the mac and linux versions in January 2020

notes.title: New Version Will arrive on 10 December 2018
notes.content:
[h1]New Version Will arrive on 10 December 2018[/h1]

Finally we can get off from Darkbasic and we will join the big boys. ːsteamhappyː

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32791109/c4679a4f93c8a1684d071de91d9ddaf6788ca48c.png[/img]

We are now working on the full screen so that it remains good throughout the game.
The minimum screen size is 1024 x 600
and the maximum is not actually there.
The game has been tested on multiple monitors.
The game will only use 1 monitor.

[b]What happens after December 10, 2018 [/b].:
The following parts are further arranged
[list]
[*] Staff
[*] Advertisement
[*] You can buy more stores.
[*] Events
[*] Expansion shop warehouse
[/list]
This will be the next version of Shop Tycoon The Boss
The intention is to have this [u]11 Feburari 2019[/u] ready.

New things that can come with it are:
[list]
[*] More different languages.
[*] New store type
[/list]
This will only come in when there are enough players.
This takes a lot of time and the translation is not cheap, unfortunately.

I hope you are as happy with the new version as we are.
A lot of fun, if there is a need for something please let me know via the forum.
Or if you run into a problem, we would like to hear from you to solve your problem.

[u][b]success and thanks for your confidence in this game[/b][/u]

notes.title: A new update is coming out today. version: 7.0
notes.content:
[h1]A new update is coming out today. version: 7.0[/h1]

When you start a store you come to a new screen.
Here you can choose your own store.
Red round is crowded area.
Orange round is normally visited
And the green is low-visited territory (not yet active)
Each store has its advantage and disadvantages such as rent price, warehouse space, electricity costs.

Once you have chosen a store, you only have to decide how long you want to rent the store.
When you have done that, you have a store.
Through the globe in the office you come to the stores.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32791109/501a3457789d4301e273d2ce29403456ec1174a9.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32791109/4cec854dcc3dea54d15c03182cf228a87ccbe5bb.jpg[/img][/url]
During the rental period you can not change shop.
After the end of the rental contract, go to the stores for a new lease or maybe you choose another store

notes.title: error restored
notes.content:
[h1]First mistake:[/h1]
After the first week the screen remained in black, when you clicked the clock again with the mouse.

[h1]The second mistake:[/h1]
Was that after the first week, that you no longer got customers, this was caused by sick staff regardless of whether or not you had staff.

After further thorough testing, I could not find any other errors.
So now I can continue to develop the new part of the game.

notes.title: Improvements in the game
notes.content:
We have made a number of improvements.
these improvements will give the game more challenge.
Even in certain periods more or fewer customers will come.
think about Christmas.

We also have the save and load options on order again, you can save up to 5 games.
In addition, we have an autosave built in, after every week it is automatically stored.

We have also adjusted the products, for example socks need 1 storage space while a welding machine requires 4 storage space, or a printer needs 3 storage space.
so you have limited storage space, so you have to choose which products you want to sell.
You can always build more storage space, but that costs a lot of money.

To date, we have made the game playable and challenging. and important functions such as saving and loading, auto save built-in.
However, full screen that currently can not. that has to do when we are going to apply that then some images look mega bad.
When there is a lot of demand for this function, we want to build it up

What's next for the start of the sale:

 [b] * Events[/b]
    This may be that you become ill peronally, or that your cash register does 
    not work anymore and even more
    of this kind of business.

[b]* Newspaper[/b]
    The newspaper indicates whether there is a certain event such as 
    Christmas sale
    or that certain products become duuder by the oil price or by a strike that
    you can not sell goods. and what else can occur


[b]* Choose the location of the store.[/b] an A location or a cheaper location B or C

 when setting up the store, that you can choose in which country, and in 
 which city.
 in large cities the rent is higher but more customers than in small towns, 
 rent is lower and fewer customers.
